payload.summary: Set private-read and independent bearer/feed revocation semantics
payload.detail: 2026-11-05 backend audit (F01, F02), local source33f6478: Immediate private GET revocation policy remains unsettled; established verified-token read fast path and separately issued bearer/feed scope/expiry remain intentional constraints. Next: Specify which private reads need live account bans/revocation, freshness bounds and behavior for independently issued feed/signed credentials; then implement and verify only the selected policy. Acceptance: Real Auth two-user expired/revoked/blocked/session-refresh tests match documented policy across HTTP/cache/export/feed paths. Do not equate sign-out with automatic revocation of every independent credential. Suggested owner: Identity + product owner. No merge, deployment, live migration, provider spending or specialist approval is granted by logging this task.
